name: com.asf.appcoins.sdk.ads.poa.SDKPoAService
description: The AppCoins Ads SDK uses this Service in its AppCoins Wallet campaign verification flow. The SDK registers campaigns and sends time-stamped confirmations while the app is in the foreground through this connection.
disableEffect: AppCoins ad campaigns that rely on the Wallet connection will no longer exchange their attention confirmations through this service.
